description: Raw single-take reaction clips: the stream's own layout stays visible, calm white captions with the spoken word lit amber, no zoom, no sound effects. Built from the research on the Kai Cenat / N3on reaction clips that travel (docs/SHORTS_RESEARCH.md E, H).
